title: Split screen: Players page, shared radar, full gear for every seat
summary: Every split event (Freestyle, Race, Games, Hockey, Tag) now opens the original's Players page for pad 2–4 to join and ready; each seat picks ATV, rider, jersey line, helmet, goggles, gloves, boots and paint. The shared race radar centers on the divider in 2P and on the quarters' crossing in 3/4P. 3/4-player stunt text uses the original's smaller 1.5 scale.
details: Pads 2–4 press START on the Players page to join and ready; the event starts once player 1 and every joined player are ready, or with 'Start Event · N Players'. Keyboard, mouse and touch drive the rows. The race radar is the original's single shared overlay with red, blue, green and yellow player dots.
limitation: The Players page lacks the original's stats row and profile name widgets and its preview panel is empty. Radar scale in split is untraced. No per-player audio mix yet. Records and credit for players 2–4 await a decision.
